envelope.description: strict block-object envelope in asset space (X width, Y up, Z depth; front -Z; pivot at footprint bottom centre)

roof_platform.description: ONE flat empty platform per model. The WALKING SURFACE is the model apex at y = 1.00; nothing exists above it; the 30 cm above it is empty (stacking safe). The perimeter fascia is a flush 0.04 band whose top is the walking surface (protrusion above the top = 0.00).

uv_space.model: one fixed patch per VANILLA MATERIAL taken from that material's own real 1024x1024 _D albedo texture (ART-05); there is no shared 2048 ART-01 atlas any more
uv_space.game_sampling: AutoAtlaser remaps uv_atlas = uv * (1/sizeMultiplier) + cell_offset, so the normalized position inside the material's own texture is preserved; material _Color multiplies the sampled albedo

thresholds.std_definition: max over R,G,B of the population std of the patch pixels (raw sRGB 0..255 bytes) - recomputed by art/png_stats.py

large_shell_policy.reason: their entire albedo is warning-stripe paint; any large face would read as a hazard sign (user bug 2026-10-27). They stay in MATERIAL_WHITELIST for completeness but must never appear in a shipped model.

construction_metal.reason: construction stage shares one UV set across factions: BaseMetal.Folktails and BaseMetal.IronTeeth (metal slot) must sample the same normalized window; the two vanilla sheet-metal textures have the same atlas layout, so one plain-sheet window is flat and representative in both

construction_wood.reason: construction stage shares one UV set across factions: BaseWood_Brown.Folktails (wood slot, FT) and RoofPlanks.IronTeeth (wood slot, IT) must sample the same normalized window; both are representative dark raw-timber tones and both stay under their class std budget inside this window
